headline: HSBC plans to shift senior staff pay to bonuses starting in 2028
summary: HSBC plans to shift senior staff compensation from fixed allowances to performance-based bonuses starting in 2028.
why: HSBC Holdings is one of the world's largest banking and financial services organizations, with substantial operations across Asia and Europe.

impacts.name: HSBC Holdings
impacts.why: Restructuring executive compensation components alters fixed cost burdens and risk-alignment incentives within the bank.
